card.name: Quantity words "more" and "most"
card.fires_on: The words "more" or "most" used as quantity words after verbs like charged, receive, or has the, where a thing being counted or paid comes next.

modes.label: most after the
modes.description: "most" after "the" meaning the largest amount, before a noun like poor people or CO2.
modes.example: it is South Asia which has the<< most>> poor people, with 595

modes.label: more after a verb
modes.description: "more" as an amount of money or goods after a verb like charged or receive.
modes.example: mill owners who frequently charged<< more>> for goods than stores outside the mill villages

card.writes: It pushes toward words like money and calories, and away from plural measure nouns like prices, sizes and rates.
card.plain: It marks "more" or "most" when they mean a larger amount of something, such as money.
